title: Nets of Ten

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: The fishing boats are back, nets full to bursting! Fishermen count their catch in tens: it's quicker than counting one by one.

intro.speaker: mara
intro.text: Would you fill each net? Five in each for now.

steps.speaker: mara
steps.prompt: Put five fish in each net. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a net with an empty dip, and put a fish there.

older.prompt: Ten fish in each net, four nets. Count carefully: ten, twenty, thirty, forty!

feedback.full: That net's full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Five, ten, fifteen, twenty! Twenty fish for the market.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: When you count in fives and tens, big numbers become easy. Sailors have always known that!

journal_line: I counted the fishermen's catch into nets with Captain Mara.

outro.speaker: mara
outro.text: Four nets of ten: forty fish! Ten, twenty, thirty, forty. Sailors have always counted that way.
